name: strDesc
meaning: Human-readable device name: the D3D device name ("Direct3D HAL", "RGB Emulation", ...) for the primary display driver, or the DirectDraw driver description for a secondary driver. Shown in the launcher's device combo.

name: pDeviceGUID
meaning: Points at guidDevice in the same record. Passed to IDirect3D7::EnumZBufferFormats and IDirect3D7::CreateDevice. This self-pointer-next-to-value shape is the DX7 SDK D3DEnum_DeviceInfo idiom.

name: guidDevice
meaning: The D3D device CLSID. memcmp'd against IID_IDirect3DHALDevice (0x577718) and IID_IDirect3DTnLHalDevice (0x577708) to decide VIDEOMEMORY vs SYSTEMMEMORY for the z buffer, textures and vertex buffers.

name: ddDesc
meaning: Copy of the device's D3DDEVICEDESC7. Sub-offsets confirmed against the asm: +0x00 dwDevCaps, +0x04 dpcLineCaps, +0x3C dpcTriCaps (dwTextureCaps at +0x5C), +0x74 dwDeviceRenderBitDepth, +0x84/+0x88 dwMaxTextureWidth/Height, +0xC4 deviceGUID.

name: bHardware
meaning: dwDevCaps & D3DDEVCAPS_HWRASTERIZATION (0x80000). A device is only kept when it is hardware or it is the primary display driver.

name: pDriverGUID
meaning: DirectDraw driver GUID pointer, NULL for the primary display. Passed straight to DirectDrawCreateEx.

name: guidDriver
meaning: The DirectDraw driver GUID that pDriverGUID points at (zero/unused for the primary display).

name: ddDriverCaps
meaning: DDCAPS of the hardware driver (dwSize 0x17C). Only dwCaps2 (+8, tested for DDCAPS2_CANRENDERWINDOWED 0x80000) is read.

name: ddHelCaps
meaning: DDCAPS of the HEL (emulation) side, filled by IDirectDraw7::GetCaps and copied along but never read.

name: modes
meaning: Array of DDSURFACEDESC2 display modes, 100 slots. modes[0] is the width-0 "Windowed Mode" pseudo-entry when the driver is the primary display and reports DDCAPS2_CANRENDERWINDOWED. Fields used: dwHeight +0x08, dwWidth +0x0C, dwRefreshRate +0x18, ddpfPixelFormat.dwRGBBitCount +0x54.

name: modeCount
meaning: Number of modes in the array; set to 1 by the windowed pseudo-entry, then incremented once per EnumDisplayModes callback, then rebuilt by the bpp filter and again by the constructor's width filter.

name: modeIndex
meaning: Currently selected mode. The value that reaches D3DApp_CreateDevice is set by the launcher's WM_INITDIALOG, which Play! re-runs: CB_GETCURSEL on combo 0x3ec, a combo POSITION, via D3DApp_SetModeIndex 0x404e86 (0x402f08-0x402f2e). Only the Accept handler uses CB_GETITEMDATA. Render_Present treats index 0 as "windowed", which is only correct on an unfiltered list.

name: bDesktopCompatible
meaning: 1 when the bpp-filtered mode list still began with the width-0 windowed pseudo-mode, i.e. the device can render into a window at the desktop depth. D3DApp_CreateDevice and Render_Present both branch on it.
